cells.gaps: The central bank's 79% for June 2026 counts people with active accounts and is not a survey; the newest survey, Global Findex for 2024, puts adults with an account at 43%.
cells.note: Global Findex 2025 puts Egyptian adults with a formal account at 43% in 2024, a quarter or more; as with Morocco, the survey stands over the central bank's account-based 79%. It is under half.
